mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY growth > 2.5% does not correlate with tighter monetary policy.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the drop in UNRATE does not correlate with improved corporate earnings.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three months signals strengthening demand in the economy, which boosts corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of periods with sustained HOUST increases, or the correlation between HOUST and corporate revenues weakens significantly (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2% YoY, it signals a restrictive monetary policy in a slowing economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: restrictive monetary policy in a slowing economy
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction between high FEDFUNDS and low GDPC1 growth does not correlate with negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the decline in INDPRO does not correlate with negative market returns.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% in a month signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the increase in RSAFS does not correlate with improved corporate revenues.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2%, it signals a strong labor market, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction between PAYEMS and UNRATE does not correlate with positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is above 3% YoY, it signals accommodative monetary policy in an inflationary environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: accommodative monetary policy in an inflationary environment
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction between low FEDFUNDS and high CPIAUCSL does not correlate with positive returns.
